# Waller V1.0.10

## New
- Per-image Home Screen Widget: add any wallpaper as its own widget and it opens straight to that image (#81)
- New Stats screen to manage storage (#70)
- Carousel service status indicator in Settings (#80)
- Background update notifications: checks weekly, notifies you when a new version is out, and jumps you to the update screen (#78)
- Version-numbered APK downloads: release APKs are named `waller-v1.0.10.apk` (#51)

## Improvements
- Redesigned Info modal, rebuilt Settings screen, and a new self-contained image-stats DB (rollback journal)
- Quicker app start with boot logging (parsing out black screen) (#72)
- Removed loading GIF before displaying high res img (#76)

## Fixes
- Shadow at the back of buttons in light mode
- Widget stability and error-handling improvements
